descriptionAdvanced.en: Mi Teleférico is a revolutionary mass transit system that has completely transformed urban mobility in the high-altitude metropolitan area of La Paz and El Alto. Launched in 2014, it is the highest and longest urban cable car network in the world, consisting of ten interconnected lines identified by vibrant colors. The system was designed to solve the immense logistical challenge of moving people between the deep canyon of La Paz and the high plateau of El Alto, bypassing the congested and steep roads. Beyond its practical efficiency, Mi Teleférico has become a major tourist attraction, offering passengers breathtaking, bird's-eye views of the city's unique topography and the surrounding snow-capped Andes. It is powered by clean energy, making it a global model for sustainable and socially inclusive public transportation.

en: The network covers a total length of over 30 kilometers and has over 30 stations.
It transports more than 150,000 passengers per day on average.
The system has received international awards for its innovative approach to urban transport and social integration.
The highest point of the network reaches an altitude of over 4,100 meters above sea level.
